bloodlines.arcana: Increase a spell's save DC by 1 whenever both you and its target are underground.

powers.name: Tremor
powers.summary: As a standard action, attempt to trip one creature within 30 feet using sorcerer level plus Charisma modifier as your CMB. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Rockseer
powers.summary: Gain dwarf stonecunning, or improve its bonus to +4. At 9th level gain tremorsense 30 feet; at 15th see through solid objects for a number of rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level.

powers.name: Crystal Shard
powers.summary: Give a touched metal or stone weapon or up to 50 ammunition bane against earth creatures, oozes, and stone or metal constructs for 1 minute, once per day and more often at levels 17 and 20.

powers.name: Earth Glide
powers.summary: Glide through natural earth or stone without leaving a trace at half your normal speed for 1 minute per sorcerer level each day, spent in 1-minute increments.

powers.name: Strength of Stone
powers.summary: Gain DR 10/adamantine and immunity to petrification, squeezing penalties, forced-movement combat maneuvers, and push or pull effects while grounded.

bloodlines.arcana: After targeting one creature with a spell, gain an insight bonus equal to half the spell level, minimum 1, to AC and saves against that creature for 1 round.

powers.name: Lullaby
powers.summary: Use lullaby as a spell-like ability for 1 minute without concentration and impose a -4 penalty on saves against sleep effects. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Combat Precognition
powers.summary: Gain a +1 insight bonus on initiative checks at 3rd level and every 4 sorcerer levels thereafter.

powers.name: Dreamshaper
powers.summary: Manipulate memories as modify memory or question a corpse as speak with dead, once per day and more often at levels 17 and 20, with a Will save to negate.

powers.name: Eye of Somnus
powers.summary: Once per day project an arcane eye that can become stationary and visible, transforming into a symbol of sleep for all who see it.

powers.name: Solipsism
powers.summary: Become incorporeal for 1 minute per sorcerer level, spent in 1-minute increments, gaining the incorporeal subtype and its normal interactions with corporeal attacks and spells.
